title: Fulfilment Service Entry Criteria — Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment
content:
Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is sold as six fulfilment services, held in the order set out below. An
order is placed under one of them, and a service is open to an order only where the order meets that service's entry
criteria.

| Rank | Fulfilment service | Entry criteria |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Standard Parcel Delivery | the main item weighs at most 22 kilograms, and the goods go by parcel carrier |
| 2 | Store Pickup Hold | the stock is available at the store, and the goods go by customer collection |
| 3 | Threshold Delivery | the main item weighs at least 22 kilograms, and the goods go by two people to the threshold |
| 4 | Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | the main item weighs at least 22 kilograms, the goods go by two people into the home, and haul-away is offered |
| 5 | White Glove Delivery and Installation | the main item weighs at least 22 kilograms, the goods go by two people with installation, and installation has been bought |
| 6 | Business Dock and Freight Delivery | the profile is a business account, the goods go by dock or freight, and a dock is available |

## Weight read on both sides of the figure

The parcel service is open to a main item of at most 22 kilograms; the three two-person services are open to a main
item of at least 22 kilograms. An item of 18 kilograms therefore meets the parcel ceiling and not the two-person
floor, an item of 40 kilograms meets the floor and not the ceiling, and an item of exactly 22 kilograms meets both
figures, so on weight alone either side is open and the remaining criteria of each service decide.

## Hypothetical selections

- A camera weighing 9 kilograms, going out by parcel carrier: the weight ceiling and the carriage criterion of
  Standard Parcel Delivery are both met.
- A refrigerator weighing 95 kilograms, going in by two people, with the old refrigerator to be taken away: the
  weight floor, the carriage criterion and the haul-away criterion of Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away are all
  met.
- A pallet of monitors for a school with a booked dock, on a business profile: the account criterion, the carriage
  criterion and the dock criterion of Business Dock and Freight Delivery are all met.
